jamie: Quick cutover PSA — tomorrow 07:00 UTC. Read asap.

jamie: New items: short embargo window (07:00-09:00 UTC) for high-risk runtime changes; priority reservation flow for Dedicated customers.

olga: Reservation flow: open infra ticket, include cluster + expected qps + customer name. Infra returns reservation token. Keep requests <=4h.

infra-bot: Reservation API enabled. Docs: https://redwood.internal/infra/reservations

sam: Canary note — last rollout showed a +25ms p95 on redwood-lite for batch sizes >8. No errors. Paused rollout and rolled back to v1.

canary-bot: Canary report: redwood-lite canary_2026-03-24_02:15 — p95 +25ms, rollout paused, rollback applied.

jamie: Runtime teams: freeze PRs that change batching, kernel selection, or scheduling until we validate. Request exemptions via @eng-leads with bench artifacts.

olga: Procedural: auto-rollback now files a follow-up ticket automatically. Please comment within 2 hours if you want manual review.

sam: I'll post micro-bench results here in ~90m.

jamie: Update the weekly changelog with reservation tokens and any canary findings: https://redwood.internal/releases/weekly. Thanks :thumbsup:
